name: claude-super-mods
description: Claude Code mods: a /goal progress bar, a prompt-cache keeper (both built on Nate Herk's claude-code-mods, MIT), a lean Haiku Explore agent and a /memorize reminder

plugins.name: goal-meter
plugins.description: A progress bar for /goal built from Claude's own task plan: compact one-line view by default, ETA, and every chat's goal in /goals

plugins.name: cache-keeper
plugins.description: Keeps a big chat's prompt cache warm (/keepwarm), warns before an expensive cold restart, shows every local chat on one board (/board), and hands a chat off to a fresh one (/handoff)

plugins.name: lean-explore
plugins.description: Replaces the built-in Explore subagent with a lean Haiku one (Read/Grep/Glob only, short answers); /lean-explore on|off|status

plugins.name: memory-guard
plugins.description: Spots sessions worth remembering, nudges once to run /memorize, and queues the ones that ended without it for the next session. Files into your wiki if you have one, else Claude Code's auto-memory.
